notes: two isnads joined by «ح»; both meet at «شريك», and the names from there on are written once after the last «ح», so they are the shared tail
«وهذا، لفظه» and «- يعني المخرمي -» are glosses, left out
«قال أبو داود في حديث وكيع» and «وحديث الأسود بن عامر أتم» are compiler remarks on wording, not routes; Shurayk is not identified
